svg.title: AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF)
svg.desc: AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF). Six perspectives and their foundational capabilities that show what an organisation must build, beyond technology, to adopt the cloud. Step 1, A technology-only plan: Plan v1 moves the servers by Q4; nobody owns the business case, skills, costs, security or ops. Step 2, Six perspectives applied: Acme rates 12 of the 47 capabilities, perspective by perspective: a gap in each, average 1.5 of 5. Step 3, The journey in practice: Envision the goals, align on 24 owned actions, launch a CCoE and a 5-workload pilot, then scale. Step 4, Pitfalls and limits: Pitfalls: no owners, skipping people and governance, CAF taken for a design; other clouds differ.

g.text: Plan v1 moves the servers by Q4; nobody owns the business case, skills, costs, security or ops.
